jobs.title: Especialista de Integración de Sistemas - Temporal
jobs.description:
Misión del puesto

Diseñar, implementar y optimizar mecanismos de integración entre los sistemas, plataformas y fuentes de información utilizados por el Programa Life Extension 2, mediante la definición de estándares, flujos de datos y soluciones tecnológicas, con el propósito de asegurar la disponibilidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información requerida para la gestión y toma de decisiones del programa, acorde a las políticas de la empresa y de los requerimientos de sus sistemas de gestión.

Responsabilidades y actividades principales

Analizar los requerimientos funcionales y no funcionales de integración del Programa LE2, identificando dependencias, restricciones, riesgos y alternativas de solución, a fin de definir diseños técnicamente viables, escalables y sostenibles.

Diseñar soluciones de integración entre los sistemas y plataformas utilizados por el Programa LE2, con el propósito de facilitar el intercambio oportuno y confiable de información entre las diferentes áreas y procesos.

Implementar mecanismos de interoperabilidad entre aplicaciones, bases de datos y herramientas digitales, a fin de asegurar la disponibilidad y consistencia de la información del programa.

Definir estándares, protocolos y lineamientos de integración de datos, con el propósito de promover la calidad, trazabilidad y gobernanza de la información.              

Administrar los flujos de intercambio de información entre plataformas corporativas y sistemas del programa, a fin de minimizar reprocesos y reducir la duplicidad de datos.

Monitorear el desempeño de las integraciones implementadas, identificando oportunidades de mejora y acciones correctivas que contribuyan a la continuidad operativa de los sistemas.

Participar en la implementación de nuevas plataformas digitales, evaluando requerimientos de integración, compatibilidad y confidencialidad de los datos, con el propósito de asegurar su incorporación eficiente al ecosistema tecnológico del programa.

Desarrollar documentación técnica, diagramas de arquitectura y procedimientos asociados a las integraciones de sistemas, a fin de facilitar su mantenimiento y sostenibilidad.

Analizar incidencias relacionadas con la transferencia e integración de datos, proponiendo soluciones que contribuyan a mantener la confiabilidad de la información.

Cumplir las normas y procedimientos de Seguridad Industrial a fin de proteger la vida y salud de las personas, prevenir accidentes graves y garantizar operaciones seguras y sostenibles.

Cumplir con otras responsabilidades delegadas por su supervisión directa ligadas a su posición que aseguren la sostenibilidad del negocio.

Formación requerida

Bachiller o Titulado en carreras de Ingeniería de Sistemas, Informática, Software, Electrónica o carreras afines.

Estudios de post grado

Especialización en integración de sistemas, Arquitectura empresarial o Gestión de Datos.

Experiencia previa

Mínimo 5 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones de integración de sistemas, aplicaciones o plataformas empresariales.

Experiencia implementando interfaces, APIs, middleware o mecanismos de interoperabilidad entre sistemas.

Experiencia trabajando con plataformas corporativas de gestión de proyectos, ingeniería o gestión documental.

Conocimientos informáticos

MS Office: nivel avanzado.

Diseño de APIs - REST, OData, OpenAPI: nivel avanzado.

SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite: nivel avanzado.

AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch: nivel intermedio.

Amazon Cognito, OAuth 2.0, JWT: nivevl intermedio.

Observabilidad de Integraciones mediante Amazon CloudWatch logs y métricas: nivel intermedio.

NET 10: nivel intermedio.

React 19: nivel intermedio.

SQL Server: nivel intermedio.

Git y AWS CodeCommit: nivel intermedio.

Despliegue continuo y prácticas DevSecOps: nivel intermedio.

Idiomas

Inglés (no requiere certificado): deseable nivel avanzado.

Datos adicionales del puesto

Vicepresidencia de: Administración y Finanzas

Gerencia de: Sistemas, Telecomunicaciones y Control de procesos

Reporta a: Superintendente de Sistemas

Locación: Lima

Vacante: Temporal

jobs.title: Ingeniero de Permisos - Minería
jobs.description: ¡Estamos contratando! Únete a nuestro equipo En Compañía Minera Las Bravas, nos encontramos en búsqueda de un:* INGENIERO DE PERMISOS - MINERÍA* ‍ ¿Cuál es el desafío?Gestionar y coordinar la obtención, renovación y cumplimiento de todos los permisos y licencias ambientales, operativas y regulatorias necesarios para las actividades de la unidad minera, asegurando el estricto cumplimiento de las normativas legales y medioambientales, con el fin de garantizar la continuidad de las operaciones mineras y minimizar riesgos regulatorios.Requisitos: Titulado y Colegiado en Ing. Ambiental, Minas, Química o Recursos Naturales Experiencia mínima de 4 a 5 años en gestión y coordinación de permisos y licencias ambientales en Minería. (INDISPENSABLE) Comprensión de leyes y regulaciones en permisos ambientales y operativos (Construcción, funcionamiento, ITM, MCB, Plan de Minado). Experiencia en la gestión de estos procesos y licencias (MINEM, SENACE, ALA, ANA, MINCUL, SERFOR,SERNAP). Sólida experiencia en la preparación y participación en auditorías ambientales, además de asegurar la correcta gestión y disposición de documentación requerida para auditorías y procesos de cumplimiento. Experiencia en la negociación y comunicación efectiva con autoridades locales, organismos reguladores y comunidades. Formamos parte de Breca, uno de los grupos empresariales más sólidos e importantes del Perú y somos la primera empresa minera peruana en ingresar al ICMM (Consejo Internacional de Minería y Metales). Como parte de nuestro plan de crecimiento nos encontramos en búsqueda del mejor talento para ocupar la posición:
COMPRADOR JUNIOR

II. OBJETIVO DE LA POSICION

Gestionar la adquisición de bienes y servicios de acuerdo a las líneas de abastecimiento asignadas, atendiendo las necesidades de los usuarios internos para asegurar el suministro oportuno en las mejores condiciones económicas posibles, siguiendo las políticas y procedimientos establecidos.

Elegir la mejor alternativa de proveedor previa evaluación de cotizaciones, calidad, precio, tiempo de entrega y TCO.

Gestionar requerimientos de compra, cotizaciones, comparativos, negociaciones y emisión/seguimiento de órdenes de compra.

Diseñar y mantener dashboards de nivel de servicio, backlog, lead time, ahorros, cumplimiento de proveedores y carga de trabajo.

Integrar información proveniente de SAP, Excel y otras fuentes para generar reportabilidad confiable.

Analizar bases de datos de compras e identificar tendencias, desviaciones, oportunidades de ahorro y cuellos de botella.

Negociar y establecer Contratos Marco (FPA) de compra para ítems críticos buscando economías de escala

Participar activamente en la detección y prevención de actos y condiciones inseguras y promover el control ambiental y mantener el orden y limpieza del área.

Atender requerimientos de reparación de equipos y componentes de la mina

Asegurar calidad de datos y trazabilidad de la información

Identificar oportunidades de mejora y digitalización dentro del proceso de compras.

Realizar análisis que permitan priorizar requerimientos y apoyar la toma de decisiones del equipo.

Participar en forma activa en la implementación del Sistema de Gestión de Marcobre: Calidad ISO 9001:2015, Ambiental ISO 14001, SSO ISO 45001, LINGO, entre otros.

2 años de experiencia general

Ing. Industrial, Ing. Civil, Administración, o afines

SAP AVANZADO, OFFICE AVANZADO , POWER BI AVANZADO

AUTOMATIZACION DE REPORTES, ELABORACIÓN DE DASHBOARDS,

 Procesos de procurement, sourcing, órdenes de compra y gestión de proveedores.

jobs.title: Technical Project Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

Location:
Kidlington, Oxford, Unit 5 Technology Dr,

Roster:
Monday to Friday 

Duration:
6-months (Maternity Cover, with possibility to extend) 

Overview:

This role sits within the PMO side of Programmes, helping improve Elysia’s delivery excellence, governance, tooling and project visibility, while also providing hands-on delivery support for internal technical projects.

It is ideal for someone with a technical background who enjoys improving how work gets delivered and aspires to grow into a technical Project Manager role.

You will use data, tools and process to help teams move faster, make better decisions and deliver consistently.

Key Responsibilities

You will own the consistent setup, tracking and reporting of technical projects across programmes, ensuring project information is accurate, structured and reliable.

You will work with Project Managers and technical teams to set up JIRA projects, plans, trackers, dashboards and reporting routines across Elysia’s portfolio and projects you own, providing clear visibility of project status, milestones, risks and dependencies.

A key part of the role will be improving the operations behind project delivery, making sure tools, templates and processes are efficient, useful and followed by teams.

You will help identify gaps, inconsistencies and pain points in how projects are planned and tracked, then support improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes, governance and ways of working.

At every step, you will be supported and empowered to make an impact. We are looking for someone excited to work with technical teams and improve how projects are delivered.

What will you do:
•    Support the setup of new projects in a consistent way by creating and maintaining JIRA plans, trackers, dashboards, RAID logs, risk registers and reporting routines. 
•    Own the capture and maintenance of project baselines, so current delivery status can be compared against agreed plans for portfolio reporting and SLT reviews. 
•    Maintain SLT portfolio visibility by ensuring dashboards and reports provide a clear view of project health, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, resource and decisions required. 
•    Track cross-project dependencies, resource constraints, gaps and risks, escalating conflicts, trade-offs or capacity concerns where support or decisions are required. 
•    Support cross-team planning by helping ensure project plans are well integrated with Programme Managers’ wider plans, baselines and portfolio priorities. 
•    Provide PMO oversight to ensure Project Managers and Programme Managers keep plans, trackers and reports up to date as priorities, estimates, scope or delivery assumptions change.
•    Identify recurring pain points in how projects are planned, tracked and reported, then turn them into practical improvements to Elysia’s delivery processes and tools. 
•    Help ensure teams follow agreed planning, reporting and escalation processes in a way that is useful, lightweight and scalable. 
•    Support projects you own by maintaining plans, driving actions, tracking blockers and helping teams stay focused on agreed delivery outcomes. 
•    Own Jira, Confluence and project administration improvements that make project information easier to manage, report and act on. 
•    Build and sustain positive relationships with Project Managers, Programme Managers, technical teams, Commercial stakeholders and customers where relevant.

Qualifications and Experience

Our team values a growth mindset over an expansive CV. We encourage you to apply if you have some or all the following:
•    Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a STEM field such as Engineering or similar field. 
•    Experience coordinating or planning projects in a fast-paced engineering, software or product environment. 
•    Confident using modern project management and collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence. Experience with Structure.Gantt, Power BI or the ability to code is an advantage. This role requires experience beyond standard Office tools. 
•    Strong interest in PMO, delivery excellence, governance and process improvement. 
•    Comfortable working with project data, including plans, milestones, KPIs, budgets, risks, dependencies, actions and resource information, and able to turn it into clear plans, trackers, dashboards and reports. 
•    Well organised, detail-oriented and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to spot gaps, inconsistencies and risks early. 
•    Able to improve processes and ways of working without making them unnecessarily heavy or bureaucratic. 
•    Comfortable working with technical teams and able to understand enough technical detail to track dependencies, blockers, progress and the impact of changes
•    Strong communication skills, with the confidence to follow up with technical, customer and commercial stakeholders, clarify information, build positive relationships and help keep teams accountable to agreed actions and deadlines. 
•    Awareness of agile, software delivery or automotive standards is preferred.

About Us

At Elysia, we are at the forefront of revolutionizing the life, safety, and performance of battery systems, across markets and industries. 

As a pioneering technology company, we specialize in the development of cutting-edge software solutions that supports, optimises and de-risks the deployment of batteries, from cradle to grave, starting with design and manufacture, through to first-life monitoring and the transition to second-life or recycling.

Our team of brilliant minds and passionate experts are dedicated to pushing the boundaries in software-derived performance, both within embedded BMS and cloud-based domains. We believe in the combination of expertise in electrochemistry, battery systems and data science to build products that empower our customers to unlock the full potential of their battery assets.

jobs.title: COORDINADOR SR DE SERVICIOS AMBIENTALES Y GESTION DE RESIDUOS SOLIDOS ( TEMPORAL)
jobs.description: En el 2007 Aluminum Corporation of China (CHINALCO) creó Minera Chinalco Perú S.A. (Chinalco Perú) para construir, desarrollar y operar el megaproyecto cuprífero Toromocho. La Unidad Minera Toromocho ha sido la primera mina de cobre de clase mundial que una empresa china ha ejecutado y desarrollado desde el inicio en el extranjero. Se ubica en el distrito de Morococha, provincia de Yauli, departamento de Junín y a más de 4,500 metros sobre el nivel del mar. Cuenta con una planta concentradora que procesa aproximadamente 117,200 toneladas diarias de mineral. Hoy, Chinalco Perú es una de las empresas más importantes de China Copper y la compañía extranjera más grande de propiedad absoluta de CHINALCO. MISIÓN DEL PUESTO: Coordinar, planificar y ejecutar los trabajos referentes al programa anual de gestión de residuos sólidos e inspecciones ambientales a fin de asegurar el cumplimiento del programa anual de actividades del área en coordinación con la Jefatura. Asimismo, ejecutar los controles requeridos en las actividades anuales planificadas respecto a la gestión de residuos sólidos. FUNCIONES:• Planificar y ejecutar el programa anual de gestión de residuos sólidos e inspecciones ambientales en coordinación con la Jefatura• Elaborar los alcances y cronogramas de los servicios para los trabajos de gestión de residuos sólidos de acuerdo a la planificación del presupuesto anual en coordinación con la jefatura.• Realizar la primera revisión de los informes técnicos sustentatorios, EDPs de la ejecución de los servicios y resultados..•Coordinar las actividades especializadas de gestión de residuos sólidos de ejecutadas en campo por empresas consultoras y contratistas, revisando la información proporcionada en los informes presentados.• Brindar soporte en la definición de acciones correctivas y levantamiento de las mismas, según desviaciones identificadas en inspecciones de residuos sólidos, cumplimiento ambiental y SSO.• Brindar soporte en representación de la empresa y del área durante las supervisiones de autoridades gubernamentales a la operación minera (OEFA, OSINERGMIN) y auditorias internas.• Brindar soporte con la documentación referente a planificación, ejecución presupuestal, normatividad, compromisos ambientales y gestión ambiental responsable, cumplimiento con la emisión de informes técnicos sustentatorios, de ejecución de actividades y de gestión ambiental de MCP y contratistas. Requisitos: 1.- Carreras: INGENIERÍA AGRICOLA, AGRONOMÍA , INGENIERÍA AMBIENTAL , INGENIERÍA QUÍMICA2.- Experiencia: 6 años en general, 4 años en el sector minería, 3 años en el puesto3.- Herramientas Tecnológicas: ARCGIS (Intermedio) , AUTOCAD (Intermedio)4.- Certificaciones: Experiencia en gestión de equipos de línea amarilla5.- Licencia de Conducir AI.CONOCIMIENTOS:• Normas legales ambientales• Gestión de estudio de impacto ambiental (EIA).• Técnicas de monitoreo ambiental• Control de impacto ambiental Beneficios Compensación de acuerdo a las políticas salariales de MCP.Contrato temporal por suplencia de maternidad.

jobs.title: Asesor(a) de Planificación Comercial - Temporal
jobs.description:
Anglo American, en sociedad con la Corporación Mitsubishi, está desarrollando la operación minera Quellaveco, uno de los yacimientos de cobre más grandes del mundo, localizado en la región de Moquegua, al sur del Perú.

Quellaveco tendrá una vida de reservas de 30 años. Utilizará proceso minero de tajo abierto y flotación para producir concentrados de cobre, así como molibdeno y plata como subproductos. Se espera que Quellaveco produzca en promedio 300 mil toneladas de cobre por año en sus primeros 10 años de operación.

En Anglo American nuestra estrategia es asegurar y desarrollar Quellaveco aplicando prácticas y tecnologías innovadoras que confiamos a nuestra gente. Estamos comprometidos a convertirnos en socios para el futuro, operar con seguridad, sustentabilidad y responsabilidad.

En Anglo American nos encontramos en búsqueda de un(a)
Asesor de Planificación Comercial
para nuestro equipo de
Supply Chain.

Tendrá la responsabilidad de Desarrollar y gestionar el proceso de planificación comercial de la cadena de abastecimiento, alineando la demanda operativa, los presupuestos, y las estrategias de contratación y compras, con el fin de apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas con análisis y proyecciones confiables y ser el ancla estratégica entre Supply Chain y el equipo de Finanzas.

Funciones principales

Liderar el proceso de planificación comercial anual y metas de ahorro, coordinando la recopilación, validación y consolidación de requerimientos de bienes, servicios y contratos de todas las áreas usuarias (mina, planta, mantenimiento, etc.).

Integrar la planificación de compras y contratos con el ciclo presupuestal (Opex/Capex).

Facilitar el modelamiento de escenarios de gasto y consumo. Desarrollar modelos de proyección de gasto mensual, trimestral y anual basados en tendencias históricas, contratos vigentes, consumo estimado y planes operativos.

Monitorear el cumplimiento de la planificación frente a la ejecución real (requerimientos vs. compras vs. contratos vs. consumo).

Gestionar el portafolio de requerimientos y su alineación con el presupuesto y las metas de ahorro

Identificar desvíos y proponer acciones correctivas o ajustes contractuales y/o presupuestales.

Consolidar información y reportes ejecutivos. Elaborar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para la gerencia de Supply Chain, Finanzas y otras áreas de dirección.

Asegurar trazabilidad y consistencia de la información comercial del área.

Apoyar procesos de toma de decisiones estratégicas brindando análisis cuantitativo y cualitativo

Participar en la preparación de presentaciones para directorio, auditorías o comités ejecutivos.

Funciones y responsabilidades SHE

Conocer y aplicar los valores, principios y la Política SHE de Anglo American Quellaveco y contribuir a su visión de cero daños

Asegurar que las medidas de control para los peligros y riesgos de SHE, relacionadas con las actividades a desempeñar, se encuentren implementadas en el lugar de trabajo, para el desarrollo de una labor segura.

Cumplir los estándares, procedimientos y reglamentos internos del Sistema de Gestión; así como participar activamente en las reuniones de capacitación, concientización y formación de la cultura de Cero Daños.

Reportar oportunamente los actos y condiciones inseguras; así como los Incidentes.

Formación académica e idioma

Bachiller o titulado(a) en Administración de empresas, Ingenierías, Finanzas, Economía o afines.

jobs.title: Head of Procurement - Fortescue Zero
jobs.description:
Our Opportunity

The Power of Now

Fortescue Zero is at the forefront of advanced engineering and technology, developing high-voltage power systems, advanced battery software and electrification solutions for some of the world’s most demanding applications.

Our technology and engineering expertise extends across heavy industry, defense and elite motorsport, with involvement in global championships including Formula 1, Formula E, IMSA and the World Endurance Championship.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to help shape the contract and procurement capability that will support Fortescue Zero as it continues to innovate, grow and scale.

About the role

This role will lead the contracts and procurement function across Fortescue Zero, shaping the capability, supplier landscape and sourcing strategies required to support a fast-growing technology business.

This is an opportunity to build and transform capability, leading a global team and working across a broad supplier network.  You will have significant influence over how Fortescue Zero sources, negotiates and delivers the parts, goods and services required by our product and programme teams.

The role requires strategic procurement leadership with hands-on commercial judgement, you will help the business scale while improving cost, quality, delivery, governance, and supplier performance.

What you will do

Lead the strategic direction and performance of Fortescue Zero’s global procurement function, building the capability required to support a rapidly evolving technology business

Develop and execute procurement, sourcing, category, and supplier strategies aligned to current and future product and programme requirements

Lead key supplier relationships and complex commercial negotiations, ensuring the right outcomes across cost, quality, delivery, and risk

Oversee procurement performance and governance across major programmes, proactively managing supplier, commercial, quality, and schedule risks

Drive continuous improvement across procurement systems, data, analytics, and processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and decision-making

Provide trusted commercial and procurement leadership to program and group levels, executives and the Board, supporting strategic decisions and business growth

About you

Significant senior leadership experience across procurement, supply chain, commercial or related functions within the automotive, mining, industrial, heavy engineering, defence, aerospace or a related sector

Have led large teams and substantial purchasing portfolios, with proven ability to build, scale or transform procurement capability within a growth-oriented, dynamic organisation

Strong track record of complex supplier negotiations, commercial decision-making, program sourcing strategies, and supplier management

Strong commercial judgement and experience managing supplier, contractual, cost, delivery, and business risk

Credibility operating at executive level, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present effectively to C-suite and Board audiences

Relevant degree-level qualification, with experience of procurement technology platforms and professional procurement qualifications highly regarded

About Us

Be part of something big. Fortescue is leading the world with our plan to decarbonise our iron ore operations, projects that harness renewable energy and the development of technology that will change our planet forever.

Our Commitment

Fortescue celebrates individual strengths and team members are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. 
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

https://fortescue.com/careers

Internal Candidates / Current Contractors please apply via Success Factors Careers Portal. For further information on how to apply please visit the Fortescue Hub. 

Fortescue reserves the right to close applications early should a suitable pool of candidates be identified. Fortescue will never contact you to ask for payment of any kind, whether directly or through a third party.

jobs.description:
class="sjb-detail sjb-v1">

BACK

EC I Supervisor ( FIFO / Thermal / Generator / Mining / Caterpillar ) West Africa

Job Reference:
453 26 02 MNW

Western Africa

Posted 2 years ago

Job Description:

Our client, a flexible energy solutions provider,ere is seeking a EC&I Supervisor who will join their team in West Africa. The EC&I Supervisor is responsible for overseeing all electrical maintenance activities at the Thermal Power Plant, ensuring the seamless operation of low-voltage (LV), medium-voltage (MV), and high-voltage (HV) systems. This role ensures the proper integration of electrical equipment from generators to transformers, including cabling, switchgear, protection systems, and communication networks.

Responsibilities:

Electrical System Maintenance & Operation

Supervise and execute electrical maintenance for LV, MV, and HV systems, ensuring uninterrupted power supply.

Oversee the proper integration of generators, transformers, cabling, switchgear, and protection systems.

Ensure safe operation and maintenance of electrical infrastructure, adhering to industry standards and plant requirements.

Monitor electrical outputs, voltage regulation, and power distribution to optimize plant performance.

Troubleshoot electrical faults, relay coordination issues, and protection system failures.

Inspections, Risk Assessments & Reporting

Conduct daily electrical system inspections to identify risks, faults, or potential failures.

Analyze operating statistics and generate reports on power system performance, failures, and required corrective actions.

Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on system health, maintenance activities, and improvement plans.

Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and client requirements.

Power System Integration & Optimization

Oversee the integration of battery storage, solar, and generator systems to maintain grid stability.

Ensure proper synchronization of multiple power sources to maintain continuous and reliable energy supply.

Optimize electrical systems to enhance power efficiency, load balancing, and grid stability.

Switchgear & Protection System Management

Maintain and troubleshoot switchgear, circuit breakers, transformers, relays, and motor control centres (MCCs).

Conduct relay protection testing, fault analysis, and coordination studies to prevent electrical failures.

Ensure correct settings and calibration of electrical protection devices to safeguard plant equipment.

Team Leadership & Supervision

Supervise and mentor the Electrician, ensuring compliance with maintenance schedules and best practices.

Assign tasks, provide technical guidance, and oversee the installation, testing, and maintenance of electrical systems.

Foster a safety-first culture among electrical maintenance personnel, ensuring adherence to PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.

Safety & Compliance

Ensure full compliance with electrical safety standards, including ISO, NFPA 70E, IEC, and local regulatory requirements.

Implement preventive maintenance programs to reduce risks of electrical failures or fire hazards.

Conduct arc flash analysis, grounding system inspections, and insulation resistance testing. 

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

5+ years on maintenance of power generators, preferably in a FIFO environment.

Experience on CAT MAK CM32 or similar is required.

Benefits and Contractual information:

Expatriate FIFO Contract

Job Description:

Our client, a globally recognized leader in engineering and technology for the energy transition, is seeking a
Process Manager
with expertise in fertilizers and chemicals to join their team. Integrated within the Industry and Mineral Chemistry activities of the Process and Technologies Division, this role focuses on fertilizer process activities (phosphorus, sulfuric, potassium) and reports to the Head of the Process and Technologies Division. This is an opportunity to contribute to innovative projects in a dynamic, international environment, pushing the boundaries of sustainable chemistry and energy transition.

Responsibilities:

Lead process activities related to fertilizer production, particularly phosphoric acid, including developing production schemes, creating Process Design Packages, and performing associated tasks (modeling, technological choices, material/fluid/consumable/service balances, PFDs, equipment specifications, and establishing design criteria).

Review and verify process deliverables produced by junior engineers, ensuring quality and accuracy.

Participate in technical and design reviews to optimize fertilizer process flowsheets and resolve complex design challenges.

Contribute to the development of fertilizer technologies and know-how through R&D initiatives and licensing activities.

Provide technical support during on-site missions, including start-up assistance for fertilizer installations.

Manage and update knowledge resources related to fertilizer technology, while mentoring and training junior engineers (up to 5 team members).

Define and supervise lab and pilot testing campaigns in collaboration with the company’s lab.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

Engineering degree or Master’s degree in Process Engineering and/or Mineral Chemistry.

Minimum of 10 years of experience in the fertilizer industry (particularly phosphorus and sulfuric fertilizers), gained within an engineering company, equipment vendor, or fertilizer production company.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to work transversally and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Job Description:

Our client, a flexible energy solutions provider,ere is seeking a Maintenance Technician who will join their team in West Africa. The Maintenance Technician is responsible for executing both planned (preventive) and reactive (corrective) maintenance on the balance of plant (BOP) and generators at the Goulamina Thermal Power Plant. This role requires a high level of technical proficiency to ensure all maintenance procedures are carried out to a high standard, ensuring the longevity of equipment and reliability of power supply to meet client expectations.

Responsibilities:

Preventive & Corrective Maintenance

Execute scheduled preventive maintenance on generators, pumps, fuel systems, cooling systems, and other BOP equipment.

Carry out reactive maintenance to resolve equipment failures and breakdowns efficiently.

Conduct routine inspections of plant equipment to detect early signs of wear, leaks, overheating, or malfunctions.

Ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance with manufacturer guidelines, safety procedures, and industry standards.

Follow precise maintenance schedules and checklists to avoid operational disruptions.

Spare Parts & Component Inspection

Inspect all spare parts and components before installation to verify their condition and compatibility.

Ensure worn-out or defective parts are properly documented and reported for replacement.

Maintain accurate records of parts used, replaced, or needing reorder to ensure smooth inventory management.

Work closely with the storeman to ensure that necessary spare parts are available for maintenance tasks.

Technical Proficiency & Troubleshooting

Use diagnostic tools and equipment to assess system performance and identify faults.

Assist in troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic, and fuel system issues affecting engine performance.

Identify and suggest improvements to maintenance procedures and equipment modifications.

Documentation & Reporting

Accurately complete maintenance logs, checklists, and service records for each task performed.

Report any irregularities, equipment malfunctions, or safety concerns to the Maintenance Supervisor.

Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for major breakdowns, providing technical input on possible causes.

Safety & Compliance

Adhere to strict safety regulations and procedures, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) protocols.

Ensure the correct use of personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.

Identify and report potential hazards in the workplace to improve plant safety.

Follow environmental guidelines for handling lubricants, fuels, and waste disposal.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

5+ years on maintenance of power generators, preferably in a FIFO environment.

Experience on CAT MAK CM32 is required.

Expatriate FIFO Contract

Job Reference:
AR013

Posted 9 months ago

Chief Mine Geologist (Mining / Geology / Mining Geology / Mineral Resources / Open Pit / Bulk Commodities) – Sierra Leone

Reference Number: AR013

Job Description:

One of our Global leading clients based in the Northern Province of Sierra Leone is in search for a Chief Mine Geologist to join their team. The role

requires managing all geological functions on a mine, including resource evaluation, geological modeling, and mine planning support. Oversees exploration programs, ensures compliance with reporting standards (SAMREC/JORC), and maintains geological databases and more.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:
Lead, mentor, and manage geologists, technicians, and contractors; oversee daily geological activities aligned with mine plans.

Grade Control:
Ensure accurate sampling, logging, and ore-waste delineation; maintain ore quality for processing.

Resource & Reserve Estimation:
Supervise data collection and interpretation for resource modeling; assist with JORC/NI 43-101 compliant reporting.

Geological Modelling:
Manage geological models using Surpac, Leapfrog, or Vulcan; produce block models and reconciliations.

Reporting:
Generate regular geological reports and provide insights for production and planning.

Exploration & Drilling:
Design and manage near-mine exploration and infill drilling programs; integrate new data into operational plans.

Compliance & Safety:
Ensure geological operations meet safety, environmental, and statutory requirements; promote a safety-first culture.

Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with mine planning, production, metallurgy, and environmental teams; provide geological input for strategic planning.

Training & Development:
Conduct training programs for junior staff; facilitate skills development and knowledge transfer to build team capacity.

Requirements:

Qualification and Skill

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, or a related field.

A master’s degree in Geology or MBA will be an added advantage

Minimum of 10 years’ experience in mining geology, preferably in iron ore operations.

At least 3–5 years in a senior or supervisory role.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an accomplished Group Finance Director to lead the Group's strategic finance function during a significant phase of growth and project development. This is a high-profile executive leadership role with a strong focus on capital raising, funding strategy, treasury management and financial governance, supporting the successful delivery of a large-scale mining project.

Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Board and key financial stakeholders, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing the Group's funding strategy, leading debt and equity financing initiatives, managing banking and investor relationships, and optimising the Group's capital structure. The role will also oversee treasury across multiple jurisdictions, managing liquidity and multi-currency exposures while ensuring the Group is well-positioned to meet its strategic and operational objectives.

Beyond funding and treasury, the Finance Director will provide oversight of consolidated financial reporting, governance and risk management across the Group, ensuring robust financial controls, regulatory compliance and transparent reporting to shareholders, lenders and other stakeholders. This position plays a critical role in supporting strategic decision-making and driving the financial success of the organisation, making it an exceptional opportunity for a commercially minded finance executive with extensive mining project finance and transaction experience.

Lead consolidated, IFRS-compliant financial statements and reliable Group-level reporting.

Manage treasury and liquidity effectively across jurisdictions, minimizing multi-currency exposure risk.

Advise on capital structure and funding strategy, maintaining strong lender confidence and full covenant compliance.

Lead investor and lender negotiations and relationship management.

Oversee cross-border tax strategy and compliance.

Drive financial governance and internal controls, ensuring positive audit outcomes.

Develop financial models, budgeting, and forecasting, with clear risk visibility to the Board.

Provide financial due diligence and valuation support for investment decisions.

Requirements

:

Chartered Accountant (CA, ACCA, or equivalent).

Minimum 15 years' post-qualification experience, including at least 5 years in a senior finance leadership role, ideally within mining/resources or a related industry.

Proven ability in bank funding negotiations and capital structuring, with a track record of maintaining investor and lender confidence.

Deep understanding of treasury, IFRS, and cross-border tax and compliance frameworks, including international audit and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing multi-currency portfolios and funding operations in emerging markets, with strong currency exposure and liquidity risk management skills.

Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.

Strong commitment to integrity, transparency, professionalism, and high ethical standards.

Adaptive and decisive in dynamic financial environments.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Geologist to provide technical leadership for district-scale exploration programmes targeting sediment-hosted copper and magmatic nickel systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for integrating multidisciplinary geoscientific datasets, developing robust geological models, generating and prioritising exploration targets, and delivering technically sound exploration programmes from concept through drill testing. The role combines technical geoscientific leadership with disciplined operational execution, ensuring the safe, efficient and effective delivery of remote exploration programmes while working closely with technical specialists, contractors, government stakeholders and joint venture partners to achieve Discovery objectives.

Responsibilities:

Lead district-scale exploration programmes from concept generation through drill testing to support Discovery objectives.

Integrate geological, structural, geophysical and geochemical datasets to develop robust geological models and exploration targets.

Generate, evaluate and prioritise exploration targets using sound geoscientific interpretation and mineral systems thinking.

Develop exploration strategies, work programmes, budgets and schedules aligned with project objectives.

Plan, supervise and optimise drilling programmes, including target definition, logging, sampling and QA/QC.

Ensure the integrity, quality and governance of geological data, databases and exploration information.

Prepare and present high-quality technical reports, geological interpretations and presentations to technical and executive stakeholders.

Coordinate multidisciplinary technical inputs from geology, geophysics, geochemistry and external consultants.

Manage exploration contractors, laboratories and service providers to ensure safe, efficient and cost-effective programme delivery.

Monitor exploration budgets, forecasts and project performance to achieve technical and commercial objectives.

Identify, assess and mitigate technical, operational and project risks throughout the exploration lifecycle.

Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, government authorities, joint venture partners and local communities.

Promote safe, environmentally responsible and compliant exploration practices in line with company standards.

Mentor and develop Project Geologists and Discovery Geologists while fostering a collaborative, high-performing technical team.

Drive Discovery outcomes through technical geoscientific leadership, disciplined operational execution and continuous improvement.

Southern Africa

Posted 1 month ago

Job Description:

Our client, a leading mining company in South Africa, is seeking an experienced and commercially focused Financial Controller to join their leadership team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the finance function by ensuring accurate financial and management reporting, maintaining robust financial controls, overseeing taxation and regulatory compliance, and providing strategic financial support to operational and executive management. The role will also drive budgeting, forecasting, integrated business planning, Life of Mine (LOM) evaluations, financial modelling, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional with strong mining industry experience to contribute to the financial performance and long-term success of a major mining operation in South Africa.

Responsibilities:

Ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial results to corporate management, shareholders, lenders, and regulatory authorities.

Manage month-end and year-end close processes and ensure the integrity of financial reporting.

Lead the preparation and review of annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and company policies.

Coordinate external audits and support all statutory reporting requirements.

Oversee general ledger integrity, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial controls to safeguard company assets and ensure reporting accuracy.

Provide financial analysis and insights to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Partner with mine management, engineering, geology, processing, and operational teams to support business performance and reporting requirements.

Lead the annual Integrated Business Planning process across mining, processing, maintenance, exploration, and administration functions, including budgeting and forecasting activities.

Monitor budget performance, investigate significant variances, and support cost optimisation initiatives.

Lead the financial component of Life of Mine (LOM) planning and long-term financial modelling activities.

Collaborate with technical services, geology, mine planning, and operations teams to align financial assumptions with production plans.

Evaluate project economics, including NPV, IRR, payback periods, and long-term cash flow projections.

Conduct sensitivity analyses relating to commodity prices, operating costs, grade profiles, recovery rates, and capital investments.

Support strategic planning processes, feasibility studies, expansion projects, acquisitions, and business development opportunities.

Ensure compliance with all direct and indirect tax obligations, including corporate income tax, provisional tax, royalties, transfer pricing, and deferred tax accounting requirements.

Manage relationships with tax authorities, external auditors, and tax advisors.

Monitor changes in tax legislation and assess the impact on the business.

Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and company policies.

Support internal audit engagements and implement audit recommendations.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function.

Lead, mentor, and develop finance team members to achieve departmental objectives.

Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership.

Build strong working relationships with operational, technical, and corporate stakeholders.

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Professional accounting qualification such as CA(SA), ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent will be highly advantageous.

8–10 years of progressive finance experience.

Minimum 3–5 years in a senior finance leadership role within the mining sector.

Strong knowledge of IFRS, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and mining industry financial practices.

Proven experience in mine costing, financial modelling, and Life of Mine planning.

Experience evaluating capital projects and preparing investment analyses.

Strong understanding of corporate governance, risk management, and internal controls.

Experience managing external audits, tax compliance, and statutory reporting requirements.

Advanced financial modelling, analytical, and reporting capabilities.

Strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

High attention to detail with the ability to meet tight deadlines in a dynamic operational environment.

Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and business partnering.

BACK

Chief Geologist (Resource Estimation / Feasibility / OP / Open-Pit / Copper / Mining) Southern Africa

Job Reference:
DSS02 - OC

Southern Africa

Posted 2 weeks ago

Reference:

DSS02 OC

Job Description:

A client of ours is looking for a Chief Geologist to lead the geological function for a copper development project, which is progressing from PEA into the PFS phase and ultimately towards DFS, financing and production. The project has significant resource extension and near-mine exploration potential. The Chief Geologist will provide senior geological leadership across exploration, resource development, feasibility, and production, while overseeing the geological model, resource database, grade control, and production geology to ensure a consistent and well-characterised ore supply throughout the mine’s life.

Responsibilities:

Manage the geological database and ensure the integrity of drillhole, assay, geological, and QA/QC data.

Lead geological interpretation, 3D geological modelling, and mineral resource estimation in line with JORC, NI 43-101, or SAMREC standards.

Plan and manage exploration, infill, extension, geotechnical, and grade control drilling programmes.

Oversee core logging, sampling, QA/QC, and data quality across all drilling activities.

Lead grade control and production geology activities, ensuring accurate ore/waste delineation and consistent ore supply to the processing plant.

Integrate grade control and production data into resource models and conduct regular mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Provide geological input into short-, medium-, and long-term mine planning, PFS, DFS, and pit optimisation.

Manage geotechnical and hydrogeological monitoring programmes and provide geological input into pit stability and dewatering strategies.

Develop and manage near-mine and regional exploration programmes focused on resource replacement and growth.

Prepare and review technical reports, resource statements, regulatory submissions, and investor documentation.

Lead, mentor, and develop the geology team while promoting strong technical, safety, and environmental standards.

Ensure all geological and exploration activities comply with applicable reporting, mining, HSE, and environmental requirements.

Requirements

:

Qualification and Skill

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Geology, Geological Sciences, or a related field.

At least 10 years’ mining industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years in a senior geological position within base metals, preferably copper.

Strong expertise in geological modelling and mineral resource estimation using Leapfrog Geo, Vulcan, Datamine, or similar software.

Hands-on experience with mine fleet management and mine planning systems (e.g., Modular Mining, Wenco, Deswik, MineSight, or equivalent) and integration of geological models into operational mine plans.

Extensive open-pit geology experience, with a strong background in grade control, production geology, drilling programs, ore block definition, and mine-to-mill reconciliation.

Proven ability to manage geological teams and drilling programs across greenfield and brownfield mining projects.

Good knowledge of JORC 2012, NI 43-101, or SAMREC reporting requirements.

Strong understanding of copper deposit geology, including supergene and hypogene mineralisation and structural controls.

Experience supporting a mining project through a PEA-to-PFS or PFS-to-DFS transition.

Working knowledge of geotechnical and slope monitoring technologies, including slope radar, LiDAR, and UAV photogrammetry, with an understanding of geological and hydrogeological influences on pit stability.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an experienced

Supply Chain and Commercial Manager to lead and manage all procurement, logistics, warehousing, inventory, contracts and commercial activities at a mining operation in Malawi. Reporting to the General Manager Operations and functionally to the Chief Financial Officer, the successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient and cost-effective delivery of supply chain services while driving strategic sourcing, supplier performance, commercial governance, risk management and working capital optimisation. As a member of the Site Leadership Team, this role will play a key part in supporting operational continuity, business growth and continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement supply chain and commercial strategies aligned with operational and business objectives.

Lead procurement, logistics, warehousing, inventory management and contract management functions.

Establish and monitor KPIs to measure service delivery, inventory performance, supplier effectiveness and working capital.

Drive continuous improvement, supply chain optimisation and supplier development initiatives.

Identify and manage supply chain and commercial risks to ensure operational continuity and business resilience.

Develop and execute strategic sourcing initiatives, including tendering, supplier evaluations, negotiations and contract awards.

Establish and maintain preferred supplier agreements and strategic supplier partnerships.

Oversee commercial contracts, including negotiations, renewals, amendments, performance management and dispute resolution.

Manage domestic and international logistics activities, including freight forwarding, customs compliance and import/export processes.

Develop contingency plans to mitigate supply disruptions and logistical challenges.

Oversee warehouse operations and inventory control systems, ensuring optimal stock levels and effective management of critical spares.

Manage the annual supply chain budget and drive cost reduction and working capital improvement initiatives.

Collaborate with site and corporate leadership teams to support operational delivery, capital projects and strategic business initiatives.

Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, corporate governance requirements and health and safety standards.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Commerce, Business, Engineering or a related discipline.

Professional procurement certification such as CIPS, MCIPS, CPSM or equivalent.

Minimum 10 years' experience in mining operations with significant exposure to supply chain and commercial management.

Experience working in Africa or other emerging markets, including remote site-based operations.

Strong knowledge of procurement, contract management, warehousing, inventory control and logistics.

Experience managing import/export requirements, customs processes and international freight activities.

Sound working knowledge of ERP systems, preferably Pronto or similar platforms.

Proven experience in supplier relationship management, strategic sourcing and commercial negotiations.

Strong financial management skills, including budgeting, reporting, cost reduction and working capital optimisation.

Demonstrated understanding of health, safety and compliance requirements within a mining environment.

Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication and negotiation skills.

High levels of integrity, professionalism, resilience and attention to detail.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking an Owner’s Representative – Permitting Lead to oversee the project’s permitting and Environmental & Social (E&S) approvals through to feasibility. The role will coordinate permitting and E&S consultants, manage key regulatory workstreams, and ensure all approvals are delivered on schedule. The position will also act as the main interface with consultants, investors, lenders and regulators, ensuring E&S and permitting requirements are aligned with the project’s development capability, proven project management experience, and the ability to work on rotation at remote international sites.

Take overall ownership of the project’s permitting strategy, approvals and integrated permitting schedule.

Manage key regulatory processes, including ECC amendments, water licences, servitudes, powerline and grid approvals, and Mining Licence amendments where required.

Review permit applications and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness and alignment with the current project scope.

Oversee ESIA and ESMP updates and ensure E&S deliverables meet regulatory, investor and lender requirements.

Coordinate stakeholder engagement, public consultation, land access, servitude and landowner requirements.

Represent the project with relevant country regulatory authorities and maintain effective relationships to facilitate approvals and resolve queries.

Manage permitting and E&S consultants, ensuring agreed scopes, deliverables, quality and timelines are achieved.

Coordinate between permitting, E&S and technical teams to ensure environmental and social requirements are incorporated into the evolving project design.

Identify permitting and E&S risks, recommend mitigation measures and escalate issues where required.

Provide regular reporting on permitting progress, approval timelines, risks and mitigation measures, while supporting budget management.

BSc Environmental Science, Natural Resource Management, MSc Environmental Management

Grado académico: Bachiller o titulado
Profesión: Ingeniería industrial, Ingeniería Civil, Administración o afines.

Elaborar reportes periódicos sobre el estado de los contratos, riesgos, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora para la toma de decisiones.
Proponer mejoras en procesos, formatos y mecanismos de control que contribuyan a optimizar la eficiencia y trazabilidad de la gestión contractual.

Todos los beneficios de ley
Alimentación y alojamiento cubierto al 100%
EPS
Bonificaciones
Utilidades
Los interesados responder a las preguntas de manera clara y detallada, y adjuntar su CV.-Requerimientos- Educación mínima: Universitario
2 años de experiencia

jobs.title: COORDINADOR SR DE GESTION SAP
jobs.description: En el 2007 Aluminum Corporation of China (CHINALCO) creó Minera Chinalco Perú S.A. (Chinalco Perú) para construir, desarrollar y operar el megaproyecto cuprífero Toromocho. La Unidad Minera Toromocho ha sido la primera mina de cobre de clase mundial que una empresa china ha ejecutado y desarrollado desde el inicio en el extranjero. Se ubica en el distrito de Morococha, provincia de Yauli, departamento de Junín y a más de 4,500 metros sobre el nivel del mar. Cuenta con una planta concentradora que procesa aproximadamente 117,200 toneladas diarias de mineral. Hoy, Chinalco Perú es una de las empresas más importantes de China Copper y la compañía extranjera más grande de propiedad absoluta de CHINALCO. MISION DEL PUESTO: Coordinar, administrar y ejecutar los trabajos referentes al funcionamiento y operatividad de los módulos SAPasignados, a fin de asegurar el cumplimiento de los requerimientos de las áreas usuarias, respecto a las funcionalidades esperadas.FUNCIONES: Analizar y coordinar los requerimientos de configuraciones de las funcionalidades en los módulos asignados, en coordinación con las áreas usuarias. Desarrollar e implementar nuevas funcionalidades en los módulos asignados. Analizar, verificar y coordinar la integración de los cambios en la configuración ejecutados mediante servicios prestados por terceros respecto a los módulos asignados. Administrar los usuarios SAP de otros módulos asignados. Verificar el uso de funcionalidades implementadas. Requisitos: Bachiller en INGENIERÍA DE SISTEMAS, INGENIERÍA INDUSTRIAL, INGENIERÍA DE INFORMATICA, INGENIERÍA ELECTRONICA. Experiencia general de 6 años, en el sector de 2 años y en el puesto de 3 años. Inglés avanzado. Excel, Ms Project, SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) - avanzado. Certificaciones deseables: CERTIFICACION SAP MM / SAP HR / SAP PM / SAP FI/ SAP BW. Disponibilidad para laborar en Oficina Lima.COMPETENCIAS TECNICAS REQUERIDAS: Análisis e interpretación de business case y diseño de especificaciones funcionales y soluciones. Herramientas standar [primavera, oracle, PI system, mine star, minesight]. Conocimiento de herramientas standar [oracle] Conocimientos de bases de datos [SQL, Oracle] Conocimientos de certificacion de software Conocimientos de seguridad de información [segregación de funciones,roles, perfiles] Datawarehouse, herramientas de backup [recovery], DML, DDL y redes Metodología PMI y gestión de recursos [costos, presupuestos y personal] Herramientas de testing y conocimientos de certificación de software Herramientas standar [SAP, primavera, oracle] Lenguaje de programación [NET, visual studio, Metodologías de testeo de aplicacionesjava,etc] Negociacion tecnica con proveedores y usuarios internos Beneficios De acuerdo a la política salarial de MCP. Contrato indefinido.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Maintenance
jobs.description:
Elk Valley Resources (EVR) operates four steelmaking coal mines that employ over 5,000 people in the Elk Valley of British Columbia. We are committed to responsible resource development, environmental performance and building strong partnerships with communities and Indigenous Peoples.

EVR is proud to be part of the Glencore Group, contributing to a global portfolio of operations with a history that dates back more than 100 years in Canada

.

Are you looking for a new career opportunity? Join our team.

Application Deadline:

September 22nd

What we offer:

At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys.

EVR recognizes our employees' skills, competencies, and performance and offers opportunities with competitive compensation and benefits. We also aim to promote employee health and wellness and provide opportunities for professional development.

We believe in the power of diversity and strive each day to create a workplace where each individual is valued and respected for their contributions.

We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishing great things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs.

About the role:

Reporting to the Superintendent, Maintenance, the Maintenance Supervisor will be responsible for all maintenance activities in the shop and pit. This position combines the responsibilities for trades, schedule execution, continuous improvement, and staffing to ensure company standards are maintained. This position follows a 4x4 rotating schedule, alternating between two-day shifts and two-night shifts.

To be successful, we are looking for someone with excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, who can coordinate the efforts of others to accomplish objectives. The successful individual will thrive in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction and work well collaborating with a team. We are looking for someone with strong problem solving and decision-making abilities, who is passionate about technology and continuous improvement.

Join us in the breathtaking Elk Valley of British Columbia. Here you will find outdoor adventure at your fingertips. Whether it's biking and skiing, or the laid-back atmosphere of fishing and hiking, there is something for everyone! Come experience what work life balance is all about!

Two Annual Bonus Plans

Comprehensive Benefits Plan

Retirement Package

Health Lifestyle Account

Relocation Assistance

Participate in and adhere to health and safety programs and policies

Direct the troubleshooting of equipment failures to determine root cause and initiate appropriate remedial action

Oversee quality maintenance and repair of mine equipment to improve availability and reliability for production

Manage daily and weekly work schedules to ensure work is complete on time and on budget through usage of Short Interval Controls and ensure Preventative Maintenance compliance

Supervise contractors and employees, improving employee work performance, efficiency, and perform performance evaluations

Follow-up on current jobs and assist trades people with troubleshooting

Assist with the development of the schedule

Assist in sourcing and requisitioning maintenance supplies, equipment, and services within budgeted guidelines

Maintain vacation schedules using Vacation Allotment guidelines, recommending, and approving overtime work

Manage Key Performance Indicators, such as downtime hours, schedule compliance, and labor factor

Trade certification, technical diploma, or degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Minimum five years mining/industrial experience in maintenance and maintenance reliability in an industrial environment

Experience supervising or leading a team

Strong digital literacy and proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite®

Valid Class 5 Driver’s License or equivalent

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Vehicle Performance (Strategy & Software) - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (Summer 2027 - Summer 2028) student placement programme within the Vehicle Performance group. This is an exciting opportunity where you will work with highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates who you can learn and develop with - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience.  It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Vehicle Performance group you should be working towards a STEM degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Motorsport Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or similar. Basic experience using high level programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, JavaScript, C# and/or VBA will be required. Experience with data analysis, data visualisation, simulation tools or software application development would be advantageous.

What you will do

Fundamentally, our mission within the Vehicle Performance group is to make the car go faster and score points. During the placement you will primarily work with the Strategy & Software team and take on responsibilities such as:

Development of in-house software tools to optimise race strategy & energy management in real-time environments using timing and car data.

Analysis of car, simulation and timing data to inform strategic decision making.

Contribution to pre and post event analysis of race strategy and competitor performance.

Ensure that software is robust for use in production environments with a very high attention to detail.

Use source control and collaboration tools to maintain code whilst exercising modern best practices.

Maintenance and improvement of data pipelines to make processes and analysis more automatic.

Participation in the Ops Room during race weekends to support the team at the track. This may occasionally require unsociable working hours.

Submitting your application

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take, along with relevant exam results.

Demonstrable passion for motorsport and innovation.

Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Why you would be suitable for the role.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

jobs.title: Garage Technician - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

An opportunity has arisen for a Garage Technician to join the Jaguar TCS Racing department in a rapidly expanding and exciting work environment.

About the role

To provide the workshop and trackside garage technician function, in support of the Jaguar Formula E Teams daily operational goals.

What you will do

Operate as a Garage Technician both at the factory and at trackside events.

Manage the team’s wheel and tyre inventory in collaboration with Engineering, including preparation, TPMS unit fitting, and event management (session pressure adjustments, tyre running, supplier/engineering liaison).

Plan and administer team truck operations, including loading, inventory control, supplier liaison, and unit booking for events.

Maintain all team consumable stocks in liaison with Chief Mechanics, ensuring timely re-stock ordering and follow-up.

Oversee the team pit equipment and off-car hardware in liaison with Chief/#1 Mechanics, ensuring readiness, proactive daily maintenance, repairs, and correct storage.

Support the assembly and maintenance of race and test garage infrastructures, including repair and upkeep of garage equipment and packhorses.

Assist with freight operations, including organisation, packing, loading/unloading of shipments, and preparation of documentation (Carnet lists, truck inventories).

Act as the key contact for storage of pit equipment (current and historic), maintaining PDN documents and inventory records.

Ensure all Jaguar Racing workshop, race, and test locations remain organised, clean, and operationally efficient, utilising offsite storage as needed.

Escalate equipment or operational issues to management promptly.

Adhere to Jaguar Formula E and wider business processes and policies.

Comply with safety regulations at all venues.

About you

Motorsport event garage operational experience (both factory and trackside).

Experience in tyre management at race / test events, including pressure adjustments and liaison with engineers and suppliers.

Strong knowledge of race truck preparation / operation and stock keeping.

Familiarity with road and air freight operations.

A confident, self-starting team player, adaptable to the fast-paced, dynamic requirements of race and test environments.

What is in it for you?

Our UK benefits include:

Bonus scheme

Aviva Pension

Group Life Assurance

Group Income Protection

Electric Car Scheme

Health Cash Plan

Employee Assistance Programme

Private Medical Insurance

26 days holiday
plus
public holidays and the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days per year

Free on-site gym access and discounted national memberships

jobs.title: Industrial Placement (2027-2028) - Software - Jaguar TCS Racing
jobs.description:
Accelerate Your Career

Jaguar TCS Racing is at the forefront of electric motorsport innovation, competing in the electrifying Formula E Championship. As part of the legendary Jaguar brand, our team is dedicated to pioneering advancements in electric vehicle technology, sustainability, and performance. With a rich heritage in racing and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of electric mobility, Jaguar TCS Racing combines passion, expertise, and cutting-edge technology to compete at the highest levels of motorsport.

We operate a 12-month (September 2027 - August 2028) student placement programme within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group. This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside highly skilled and experienced engineering professionals and graduates, offering plenty of scope to learn and develop - the more questions you ask the more you will gain from your experience. It is important to know that many of our industrial placements have been successful in obtaining graduate roles on completion of their degree.

To be eligible for an industrial placement within our Formula E Car Development (Software) group you should be working towards a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related area.

What you will do

During the placement you will take on responsibilities such as: 

Working as an integral part of the Car Development team. 

Developing a new generation of software tools, APIs, and packages using the modern .NET stack (C# - candidates do not need prior experience with the language but should be confident programmers who understand core principles and are eager to learn), cloud technologies (Azure, AWS) and containerization (Docker, WSL containers). This will support the standardisation and automation of our applications including:  

Trackside car ECU monitoring/configuration and sensor calibration 

Trackside data processing 

Cloud-based technical document management 

Cloud-based event management 

Component lifing support 

Tooling to support performance and system engineer workflows 

Supporting the development and maintenance of databases in SQL (T-SQL, Postgres) and NoSQL (MongoDB). 

Writing unit, integration and mutation tests to ensure high code quality. 

Experiment with agentic coding using cutting edge frontier AI models with generous budgets (like everyone, we’re still figuring this one out!). 

Our goal is to reduce the time it takes for engineers to make valuable performance decisions over a race weekend.

Submitting your application

When applying for industrial placements opportunities, all students are expected to submit a covering letter along with a Curriculum Vitae containing the following information: 

• Your current career aims and how you plan to achieve them. 

• Subjects that you are currently taking and plan to take. 

• Relevant leisure pursuits and activities. 

• Why work experience would be beneficial to you.

Next Steps

Those students that are shortlisted will be invited to attend an assessment.  It is expected that the student takes sole responsibility for making suitable travel and accommodation arrangements.

Our Commitment

You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. At Fortescue Zero we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences and skills.  

Fortescue Zero is an equal opportunity employer who values diversity and inclusion. If you have a disability, 

We are happy to discuss reasonable job adjustments.

jobs.title: Técnico Soldador - Comas
jobs.description:
Importante taller de metalmecánica solicita un técnico soldador con disponibilidad para laborar en comas.
Misión:
Ejecutar procesos de soldadura en accesorios de diferentes tipos de materiales (acero, inoxidable) mediante técnicas de manera segura, precisa y eficiente, uniendo piezas metálicas conforme a planos, especificaciones técnicas y normas de calidad establecidos, para garantizar la resistencia, funcionalidad y durabilidad de las estructuras o productos fabricados.
Funciones del puesto:
Preparar materiales, superficies, equipos e insumos necesarios para el proceso de soldadura.
Seleccionar el proceso de soldadura, electrodos, alambres y parámetros adecuados según el tipo de material.
Operar equipos de soldadura SMAW, TIG, MIG, FCAW, entre otros.
Trabajar con diferentes tipos de metales como acero, acero inoxidable y otros materiales.
Inspeccionar la calidad de las uniones soldadas e identificar y corregir posibles defectos.
Realizar mantenimiento básico, limpieza y cuidado de los equipos y herramientas de soldadura.
Cumplir con los procedimientos de seguridad industrial y uso de EPP.
Mantener el orden y limpieza del área de trabajo y reportar cualquier falla o desviación al supervisor.
Requisitos del puesto:
Experiencia mínima de 2 años en procesos de soldaduras en plantas metalmecánicas, estructuras o minería.
Técnica y egresado en formación relacionada en soldadura.
Homologación en 3g vigente (no excluyente).
Disponibilidad para laborar en Comas.
Beneficios:
Salario acorde al mercado.
Planilla completa desde el primer día de trabajo.
Seguro EPS (opcional).
Estabilidad Laboral.
Línea de Carrera.
Eventos deportivos de integración.
Excelente Ambiente Laboral.
Modalidad de trabajo:
Lunes a Viernes: 7:00 a.m. - 5:40 p.m. - Presencial (horas extras remuneradas en caso lo requiera la operación).

-Requerimientos- Educación mínima: Técnico
2 años de experiencia
Edad: entre 22 y 50 años
Palabras clave: tecnologo, tecnico, tech, technician, technology, tecnologia, technologist, welder, soldering, soldador
